commit_message: JBLibs 1.2.31: validate resolved SFTP template mounts

replacements.old:
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_USER_MOUNT_REQUIRED = "User '{username}' must have at least one mountpoint."
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_LABEL_INVALID
replacements.new:
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_USER_MOUNT_REQUIRED = "User '{username}' must have at least one enabled mountpoint."
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_CONFIG_INVALID = "Mountpoint configuration for user '{username}' is invalid: {error}"
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_LABEL_INVALID

replacements.old:
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_USER_MOUNT_REQUIRED = "Uživatel '{username}' musí mít alespoň jeden mountpoint."
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_LABEL_INVALID
replacements.new:
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_USER_MOUNT_REQUIRED = "Uživatel '{username}' musí mít alespoň jeden povolený mountpoint."
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_CONFIG_INVALID = "Konfigurace mountpointů uživatele '{username}' je neplatná: {error}"
TXT_SFTP_PARSER_MOUNT_LABEL_INVALID

replacements.old:
__version__ = "1.2.30"

# 1.2.30: SFTP resolves managed mountpoint templates and disabled per-user mountpoints before Apply
replacements.new:
__version__ = "1.2.31"

# 1.2.31: SFTP config validation uses resolved local/template mountpoints and requires one enabled effective mount
# 1.2.30: SFTP resolves managed mountpoint templates and disabled per-user mountpoints before Apply

replacements.old:
- `check_config_valid()` should validate optional mail fields when present, but not require them.
- Validation messages returned by `check_config_valid()` are user-visible
replacements.new:
- `check_config_valid()` should validate optional mail fields when present, but not require them. Mountpoint validation must use `resolve_mountpoint_records()` for local + template state and require at least one enabled effective mountpoint per user; do not gate template users on raw `sftpmounts`.
- Validation messages returned by `check_config_valid()` are user-visible
